facts_before_fix.why_the_loader_picks_the_system_copy: with no DT_RPATH/DT_RUNPATH and no LD_LIBRARY_PATH, DT_NEEDED libcrypto.so.3 is searched in the default paths first; the install's lib is not in them. In a process that has already mapped the candidate libcrypto (SONAME libcrypto.so.3), the loader reuses that mapping, so the system copy is only picked when the module is dlopen'ed by a process that has not preloaded the candidate.

provider_probe_before.probe: candidate-linked C consumer calling OSSL_info(OPENSSL_INFO_MODULES_DIR), OSSL_PROVIDER_load(NULL,"default"/"legacy") and EVP_MD_fetch(NULL,"MD4","provider=legacy")
provider_probe_before.dlopen_probe_no_preloaded_libcrypto: before the fix: dlopen(legacy.so) succeeded but /proc/self/maps showed /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcrypto.so.3; after: /work/artifacts/phase2/install/lib/libcrypto.so.3

root_cause: The medusa NULL is not caused by the module's linkage: the candidate libcrypto's compiled-in MODULESDIR is the empty sentinel (OPENSSL_info(1003) == NULL, a recorded distribution-fact divergence), so provider_init never finds install/lib/ossl-modules/legacy.so unless OPENSSL_MODULES is set; medusa's environment did not set it. The missing RUNPATH is a separate, real hazard: it is what makes the module's DT_NEEDED resolve to the system libcrypto whenever the loading process has not already mapped the candidate libcrypto.

in_scope_repo_changes: forensics/tools/build_phase2.sh: link legacy.so with -Wl,--enable-new-dtags -Wl,-rpath,'$ORIGIN/..' (install path lib/ossl-modules -> lib). DT_RUNPATH (not DT_RPATH) so LD_LIBRARY_PATH still overrides, which the ABI-SUBSTITUTION court relies on.
forensics/tools/build_phase2_asan.sh: the same RUNPATH in the ASan sibling; updated for parity, NOT_RUN (the ASan venue was not rebuilt in S45).

forensics/tools/downstream_runtime.py: _measure_subject_runtime now sets OPENSSL_MODULES=<subject prefix>/lib/ossl-modules, the same per-subject prefix substitution as LD_LIBRARY_PATH and the same mechanism phase16/17/18/19's side_env already uses. This is the project's documented disposition for the empty MODULESDIR (PHASE-16-CLI-SEAL 5.4 and correction 3).
fix.rejected_alternative: baking OPENSSL_RS_MODULESDIR into the release build was considered and not done: it would embed a non-relocatable absolute court path in libcrypto, contradict build.rs's stated rationale for the empty sentinel and the Phase 16 recorded divergence, and would change libcrypto_so_3_sha256, invalidating every downstream row bound to the current candidate identity. The measured RUNPATH change leaves libssl/libcrypto hashes unchanged (candidate_identity: libcrypto 268420cb..., libssl a380ecd6...).
